sharedBand.title: Shared words
sharedBand.hint: Names only. A circle's size is the total count of the kinds hanging under it (derived)

legend.upper: Line to a broader word (⊂ points the way; ≡ is two-way)
legend.sharedSize: Shared-word circle = total count of its children (derived)

pick.hint: Pick two circles to join with a line (a kind, a shared word or a standard word). While selecting, clicking a circle does not leave this page.
pick.unavailable: Circles can't be selected at this level (per dataset). Click a dataset circle to open its surroundings, then select.

relations.subClassOf: ⊂ Start is a kind of the end (kinds)
relations.subPropertyOf: ⊂ Start is a kind of the end (items)

error.same: A word can't be joined to itself. Pick a different circle.
error.mixed: A kind and an item can't be joined. Pick two kinds, two items (or an item and a quantity kind).
error.cycle: This line would form a loop (the end is already below the start). Check the direction.
error.invalid: This pair can't be joined (it includes a shared word that hasn't been minted, or mixes a kind with an item).
